agent_readiness.notes: No website, so no robots.txt, schema or readable service text; only directory hours exist. Reviews are unclaimed and unmanaged. Nothing is bookable or quotable online - a customer's agent has no way to verify or contact the business except a phone number.

operations_signals.signal: A review states calls were not returned and the phone went unanswered after repeated attempts - direct evidence of missed-call leakage
Another review complains about a $163 charge not quoted upfront, indicating no standard estimate process

top_opportunities.opportunity: Missed-call rescue: a simple AI/voicemail-to-text answering service that acknowledges every call and books or texts back
top_opportunities.evidence: Review reports repeated calls with no answer or call-back

top_opportunities.opportunity: One-page site with services, hours, service area, licence info and a quote-request form (fixing the dead domain)
top_opportunities.evidence: schrumplumbing.com did not load; only directory listings exist

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim the Google profile and answer the 11 reviews; add upfront pricing guidance to fix the 'surprise bill' complaint

scores.reasons: Worst review profile in the batch (3.3/11, unreachable phone) with no website at all, but a one-person operation with little spare cash; fixes are cheap and fast, so value is real but small.

caveats: Ratings and review counts come from third-party aggregates (Birdeye, Rehab.com, ClassPass, localitybiz, magicpin, whosmypro) rather than Google Maps pages opened directly; counts may lag Google.

Several sites in this batch (Weininger, Optical Boutique, New Brunswick Counseling Center, New Brunswick Therapy, PR Lab, Anthony's) render page titles with a stray horse emoji - likely a shared SEO plugin or theme default, not something the owners typed.

A-Anthony's: the New Brunswick listing (1100 Somerset St Ste J, 732-249-7059) and the current site anthonyshomeexperts.com (220 Churchill Ave, Somerset, 908-308-2635, part of Danley 911) share a nearly identical legal name, so I treated them as the same operation - this is an inference and was not confirmed by a page stating both.
phone_layout 'broken' for Brunswick Health reflects a placeholder tel:5555555555 and a first mobile screen with no text, not a rendering failure of the page itself.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile details (claimed status, categories, photos, service list) could not be inspected directly - Google Maps pages were not opened; Birdeye's 'not claimed' banner was used as a proxy.
New Brunswick Counseling Center's robots.txt could not be retrieved (fetch failed), so crawler permissions are unverified.
Resilience Wellness Studio's ClassPass page returned HTTP 403, so the 4.9/100+ rating is from the search-result summary, not a page I opened.
No listing rating was found for New Brunswick Therapy LLC; Nastus Brothers ratings vary by aggregator (7 vs 16 reviews).
Nastus Brothers and Schrum Plumbing have no website, so website_review fields are largely false/empty by definition, and operations signals are inferred from one or two reviews.
